what_happened.line: The School Committee approved a civics project graduation requirement beginning with the class of 2023, 5-0.
The committee allowed a modified winter sports season as outlined by the athletic director; four voted yes and one abstained.
It approved all five line-item transfers from the business manager by roll call, including funds for Turkey Hill HVAC work and live-streaming software.
Fees for winter sports stay the same despite a shorter season, because bus costs rose with separate buses for each team.
The committee heard that Comcast fiber contracts are executed for two locations, with installation expected in early January, and waived the second reading of policies.

why_it_matters: The civics requirement sets a new condition for graduation for students entering the class of 2023, and the unchanged athletic fees alongside higher bus costs affect what families pay and what the district spends on transportation.
watch_next: The athletic director is to report on alpine ski arrangements once the mountains respond.
School committee protocols on public comment are to go on a future agenda.
